card.name: Digits and units in single-dose amounts
card.fires_on: The last digit or unit of a dose quantity (e.g. 500,00|0, 1.5 kg, 5,000 units, 1.45 mg), or a word such as dose in 'single-dose', just before the text says what the amount applies to.

modes.label: Final digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a multi-digit dose figure, often with commas, before the unit.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: A unit word such as mg, kg or units right after a quantity.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for a single item or a per-item amount, such as 'each time', 'a set', 'size' or 'singleton'.
card.plain: It fires as a dose amount or single-dose phrase is being completed, as the text moves on to what the amount refers to.
